حبتا (form I)
# حَبَّتَا (ḥabbatā) /ħab.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# حُبَّتَا (ḥubbatā) /ħub.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of حَبَّ (ḥabba) and حُبَّ (ḥubba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
